purpose: Replace duplicate scalar coordinate registers with live-source selectors; retain all states and handshakes.

task_leaf: DECODE: scalar_leaf, used by scalar HASH request
CHAIN_SETUP: scalar_leaf or leaf_cursor, used by scalar CHAIN or Verify request
REDUCE_SETUP/LT_SETUP/SF_LEAF: leaf_cursor, used by the immediately following scalar HASH request
PARENT_SETUP: scalar_leaf or zero, used by scalar parent HASH request
task_a: CHAIN_SETUP: chain_cursor remains fixed until CHAIN_NEXT, after hash consumption
LT_SETUP: lt_level remains fixed until LT_NEXT, after hash consumption
PARENT_SETUP: node_level remains fixed until PARENT_DONE, after hash consumption; descriptor choice is latched in source tag

notes: Selection tags retain setup-cycle timing. Coordinate sources cannot update in HASH_ISSUE, HASH_WAIT or Verify input wait.
The 20-bit leaf_cursor was truncated at the old assignment; new live wire retains the same 20-bit truncation.
The parent increment is computed at INDEX_BITS width, matching the original task_a assignment even for node_level=31.
